# China Medical Index
> An independent, source-verified guide to top hospitals in China for international patients.
> Data from free, public, authoritative sources (Fudan China Hospital Ranking, JCI, health commissions, hospital official sites).
> Collected 2026-11-19; reviewed every six months. Not medical advice.

## Facts we can verify
- Cancer Hospital CAMS (Beijing) ranked #1 in oncology, Fudan 2023.
- Peking Union Medical College Hospital: #1 in rheumatology, obstetrics/gynecology, pathology (Fudan 2023).
- Peking University Third Hospital: #1 in reproductive medicine/IVF (Fudan 2023).
- Fuwai Hospital: #1 in cardiovascular medicine and cardiothoracic surgery (Fudan 2023).
- Beijing Jishuitan Hospital: #1 in orthopedics (Fudan 2023).
- West China Hospital: #1 in anesthesiology and rehabilitation (Fudan 2023).
